findings.title: Business-Logic Race Condition in Fund Transfer (TOCTOU)
description: The transfer endpoint validates the requested amount against the account balance and then debits the account as two separate, non-atomic steps. Concurrent requests all read the same starting balance, all pass the check, and all debit.
A low-privileged user can therefore move more funds than they hold, driving the source account to a negative balance.
poc: Fire N identical transfers simultaneously with a thread barrier:
race   : 20 x POST /api/transfer {amount: 13000} -> 7 x 200 Transfer successful
recommendations: Perform the debit atomically and conditionally: UPDATE accounts SET balance = balance - :amt WHERE id = :id AND balance >= :amt; treat zero rows affected as insufficient funds.
Or wrap check + debit + credit in a single serializable transaction with a row lock.

findings.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting in Support Messages
description: User-supplied message content is stored without sanitization and rendered as raw HTML, so a stored payload executes in a support agent's authenticated session when they open the ticket.
poc: Agent opens the ticket -> payload executes in their session
recommendations: Render user content as text, not HTML; if rich HTML is required, sanitize on output with an allowlist (e.g. DOMPurify).
Deploy a Content-Security-Policy (default-src 'self'; no unsafe-inline) as defense-in-depth.

findings.title: Missing HTTP Security Headers
description: Standard security response headers (HSTS, Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy) are absent, weakening defense-in-depth and amplifying the impact of client-side injection.
poc: Response headers on / and /api/* omit: Strict-Transport-Security, Content-Security-Policy,
recommendations: Add CSP, HSTS (max-age >= 31536000; includeSubDomains), X-Frame-Options: DENY, and X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff (e.g. via helmet).
